name: The Eye of Zuldazar
label: Quest
description: The Eye of Zuldazar: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Tales of your battles against the Gurubashi are whispered in the winds, priest. Even royalty is beginning to talk of your deeds. It is rumored that King Rastakhan even mentioned you by name.
The time has come to imbue the Eye. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the service.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Be resolute in your endeavors, friend. The Soulflayer will attempt to siphon your will to live.
